description.content: Eve's default Nano Suit, automatically equipped at the start of the game.
Obtained by default at the start of the game. Automatically equipped when no other Nano Suit is worn.
Automatically acquired upon downloading Update 1.003.
Automatically acquired upon downloading Update 1.003.
Automatically acquired upon downloading Update 1.011.
Automatically acquired upon starting New Game Plus.

When you arrive in the Flooded Commercial Sector, exit the monorail and look to the left. Continue down the stairs here and proceed into the half-open door to find a black box containing Nano Suit - Planet Diving Suit (7th) V2.
Replaces Planet Diving Suit (7th) V2 on NG+. Exit the monorail in the Flooded Commercial Sector and head left down the stairs into the half-open door.
Replaces Planet Diving Suit (7th) V3 on NG++. Exit the monorail in the Flooded Commercial Sector and head left down the stairs into the half-open door.

After draining the water during the side quest "Oblivion", make your way to the very bottom of the now drained Flooded Commercial Sector. Follow this lower path to the very end, defeating a Cricket Slasher as you go. At the end you will find a black box with Nano Suit - Wasteland Adventurer.
Replaces Wasteland Adventurer on NG+. Found at the bottom of the drained Flooded Commercial Sector after completing the "Oblivion" side quest.
Replaces Wasteland Explorer on NG++. Found at the bottom of the drained Flooded Commercial Sector after completing the "Oblivion" side quest.

Once you are able to use the cranes in the Construction Zone, use the right-hand crane first. Use this to push the girder into the sculpted wall to the right of the sewer entrance. This will break it, revealing a small room behind. Position the girder on the crane so that you can jump across to it and then over to the newly revealed room. You will find a black box here containing Nano Suit - Red Passion.
Replaces Red Passion on NG+. Found in the hidden room in the Construction Zone, accessed by using the crane to break through the sculpted wall.
Replaces Emerald Passion on NG++. Found in the hidden room in the Construction Zone, accessed by using the crane to break through the sculpted wall.
Found in a crate near the Safehouse Supply Camp in Xion. Requires the Complete Edition or the Tachyon Pack DLC.
Found in the Deluxe crate near the Safehouse Supply Camp in Xion. Exclusive to the Digital Deluxe Edition.
Found next to the Christmas tree in Xion. Head straight from the entrance, up the stairs, and interact with the presents in front of the tree. Make sure Seasonal Events is enabled in your settings.
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Replaces Planet Diving Suit (2nd) in Roxanne's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Replaces Orca Exploration Suit in Roxanne's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Replaces Keyhole Suit in Roxanne's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 3 Affinity. (Added in Update 1.004)
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 3 Affinity. (Added in Update 1.003)
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 3 Affinity. (Added in Update 1.003)
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Replaces Cybernetic Dress in Roxanne's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after gaining level 3 Affinity. (Added in Update 1.011 on June 12, 2025)
Available to purchase from Roxanne's shop after returning from Spire 4 and defeating the Unidentified Naytiba.
Replaces Prototype Planet Diving Suit in Roxanne's shop on NG+. Available after returning from Spire 4 and defeating the Unidentified Naytiba.
Available to purchase from Lyle after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Replaces Daily Biker in Lyle's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Lyle after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Replaces Black Full Dress in Lyle's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 2 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Lyle after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Replaces Junk Mechanic in Lyle's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Available to purchase from Lyle after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Replaces Daily Denim in Lyle's shop on NG+. Available after gaining level 3 Affinity.
Acquired as the reward for completing the "Memories in the Doll" side quest.
Replaces Fluffy Bear as the reward for the "Memories in the Doll" side quest on NG+.
Acquired upon completion of the "Encounter" side quest, which is given to EVE once she reaches level 2 Affinity with Kaya's shop.
Replaces Sky Ace as the reward for the "Encounter" side quest on NG+. Requires level 2 Affinity with Kaya's shop.

Reward for collecting all 49 [[collectibles/cans|Cans]] scattered throughout the game. Claim it from the Can Vending Machine next to the Safehouse Supply Camp, between Adam's Tetrapod and Lily's Workshop in Xion.
NG+ exclusive. Available to purchase from Lyle's shop on NG+.
Reward for completing the [[walkthroughs/bulletin-board-requests/photography-club|Photography Club]] bulletin board request. Added as part of Photo Mode in Update 1.009.
Reward for completing the [[walkthroughs/bulletin-board-requests/cat-photo-exhibition|Cat Photo Exhibition]] bulletin board request. Added as part of Photo Mode in Update 1.009.
Reward for completing the [[walkthroughs/bulletin-board-requests/like-butterflies|Like Butterflies]] bulletin board request. Added as part of Photo Mode in Update 1.009.
Reward for completing the "Pisces" bulletin board request. Added as part of Photo Mode in Update 1.009.

Head northeast of the Solar Tower and climb the cliffs up to the large open area to the northwest. Head east and drop down onto the rocks, here you will find a black box here containing Nano Suit - Racer's High.
Replaces Racer's High on NG+. Head northeast of the Solar Tower, climb the cliffs to the open area, then drop down onto the rocks to the east.
Replaces Speeder's High on NG++. Head northeast of the Solar Tower, climb the cliffs to the open area, then drop down onto the rocks to the east.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nier-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nier-automata#finding-emil|Emil's shop]]. Requires the NieR Automata DLC.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nier-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nier-automata#finding-emil|Emil's shop]]. Requires the NieR Automata DLC.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nier-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nier-automata#finding-emil|Emil's shop]]. Requires the NieR Automata DLC.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nier-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nier-automata#finding-emil|Emil's shop]]. Requires the NieR Automata DLC.

Head east from the Altess Levoire entrance, go through the gate and then climb up the cliff face to the northeast of you. Follow the cliffs up and to the west. Then, you'll have to do some more platforming involving jumping across poles. Once you reach the other side, before crossing the bridge, you will find a black box with Nano Suit - Crew Style.
Replaces Crew Style on NG++. Head east from the Altess Levoire entrance, through the gate, up the cliff face, and across the poles to the black box before the bridge.
Use the code βθαλδζ on the ship container to the west of the Western Grand Canyon Supply Camp (part of the “Recruit Passcode Specialists” Request).
Replaces La Vie en Rose as the reward for the "Recruit Passcode Specialists" request on NG+.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nikke-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nikke#finding-scarlet-and-volt|Volt's shop]]. Requires the Goddess of Victory: Nikke DLC.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nikke-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nikke#finding-scarlet-and-volt|Volt's shop]]. Requires the Goddess of Victory: Nikke DLC.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nikke-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nikke#finding-scarlet-and-volt|Volt's shop]]. Requires the Goddess of Victory: Nikke DLC.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nikke-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nikke#finding-scarlet-and-volt|Volt's shop]]. Requires the Goddess of Victory: Nikke DLC.
Available from [[walkthroughs/nikke-dlc/stellar-blade-x-nikke#finding-scarlet-and-volt|Volt's shop]]. Requires the Goddess of Victory: Nikke DLC.
Next to the human body where the memorystick came from is a small box where this Nano Suit can be found.
Replaces Holiday Rabbit on NG+. Found in the small box next to the human body where the memorystick was.
Replaces Holiday Bunny on NG+. Found in the small box next to the human body where the memorystick was..

Drop down, push the orange box through the main gate and onto the big platform. Then jump up and climb the rope, interact with the chest, and shoot all the targets except the red ones before they disappear. Do that and this nano suit is all yours.
Replaces Cyber Magician on NG+. Complete the same shooting challenge: push the orange box, climb the rope, and hit all targets except red ones.
Replaces Cyber Trickster on NG++. Complete the same shooting challenge: push the orange box, climb the rope, and hit all targets except red ones.
In a chest where the Brute came from in the Forbidden Area. Directly behind Tommy's body.
Replaces Sporty Yellow on NG+. Found in the chest behind Tommy's body in the Forbidden Area.
Replaces Sporty Energy on NG++. Found in the chest behind Tommy's body in the Forbidden Area.
In the next open-ish area, there's a train carriage (after a fight with a handful of enemies) on the south wall. Down the end is a crate with this Nano Suit inside.
Replaces Daily Knitted Dress on NG+. Found in the crate at the end of the train carriage on the south wall.
Replaces Comfort Knitted Dress on NG++. Found in the crate at the end of the train carriage on the south wall.
If you head back up and head south-southwest a Skull will crash through the wall. Defeat the enemies and go into the room where the Skull crashed through from.
Replaces Daily Mascot on NG+. Found in the room the Skull crashed through from, south-southwest after heading back up.
Replaces Comfort Mascot on NG++. Found in the room the Skull crashed through from, south-southwest after heading back up.
As you leave, look up to the right of the entrance, there's a chest there with this nano suit design inside.
Replaces Daily Force on NG+. Found in the chest up to the right of the entrance as you leave.
Replaces Comfort Force on NG++. Found in the chest up to the right of the entrance as you leave.

After obtaining [[collectibles/documents#strange-information|Strange Information]] from completing the [[walkthroughs/bulletin-board-requests/strange-signal|Strange Signal]] bulletin board request, fast travel to the [[collectibles/camps#temporary-armoury-supply-camp|Temporary Armoury Supply Camp]], head left, and take the elevator back up. Follow the path right past the Cricket Butchers, the dev room door is on the left, passcode θεθλβλ. The Ocean String chest is in the second chamber, passcode θβδζκε.
There's one to the south of the previous collectible but it won't open. Need to have accepted the “Precious Treasure” request to open it.
Replaces Blue Monsoon on NG+. Requires accepting the "Precious Treasure" request to open the crate south of the previous collectible.
Replaces White Monsoon on NG++. Requires accepting the "Precious Treasure" request to open the crate south of the previous collectible.
From there, head west, before then jumping up to the roof to the south. The Nano Suit is up there.
Replaces Black Wave on NG+. Found on the rooftop to the south, reached by heading west then jumping up.
Replaces Wild Wave on NG++. Found on the rooftop to the south, reached by heading west then jumping up.

Free the yellow box by exploding the barrels, then use it to climb up the north wall, before heading out the back and scaling around the outside of the building to get to the top. When up there use the poles to get across to the Nano Suit crate.
Replaces Daily Sailor on NG+. Explode the barrels to free the yellow box, climb the north wall, scale the outside of the building, and use the poles to reach the crate.
Replaces Comfort Sailor on NG++. Explode the barrels to free the yellow box, climb the north wall, scale the outside of the building, and use the poles to reach the crate.
Just west of the Oasis Supply Camp, underwater, is a locked supply crate. Contains the Cybernetic Bondage Nano Suit Design Pattern. Passcode to get in is: λλλλαθ
Replaces Cybernetic Bondage on NG+. Found in the locked underwater crate west of the Oasis Supply Camp. Passcode: λλλλαθ
Replaces Autonetic Bondage on NG++. Found in the locked underwater crate west of the Oasis Supply Camp. Passcode: λλλλαθ
Reward for catching all 25 Fish. Once your fish data bank is full, head to Clyde's fishing shack in the Oasis and he'll give you the outfit.
Found while fishing in the Oasis using strange bait while wearing the Ocean Maid Nano Suit.
Available to purchase from Clyde's shop in the Oasis. Added as part of the Summer Update in Update 1.006.
Available to purchase from Clyde's shop in the Oasis. Added as part of the Summer Update in Update 1.006.

Instead of heading to the right and going to the yellow box, there's an offshoot in the right-hand corridor to the right. Head in there, defeat all the enemies, while avoiding all the lasers, and this Nano Suit is all yours.
Replaces Planet Diving Suit (3rd) on NG+. Found in the offshoot corridor to the right, past the laser traps and enemies.
Replaces Planet Diving Suit (3rd) V2 on NG++. Found in the offshoot corridor to the right, past the laser traps and enemies.

From the second Cocoon, drop down the yellow ledges and you'll be able to jump over to an island-like area where there will be a Drone Upgrade Module on top of a car. From there, jump across to the building with the pillars. You'll have to swim through the water for a little bit which will slowly kill you, but you'll make it there before you die.

Once you're across, climb up to the top from the yellow ledges on the side. Once you're on the roof, jump up to the top and go through the door. The crate will be to the left once you're inside. (If you pre-ordered the game, and already got the nano suit out of the pre-order crate, you'll only get Vitcoins out of this crate instead).
Replaces Planet Diving Suit (6th) on NG+. Reached by jumping from the second Cocoon across to the pillared building, swimming through the water, and climbing to the rooftop.

Replaces Planet Diving Suit (6th) V2 on NG++. Reached by jumping from the second Cocoon across to the pillared building, swimming through the water, and climbing to the rooftop. (If you pre-ordered the game, you may have already received this suit from the pre-order crate.)

To the south are some tracks. Get on them, head west to the end of the parking garge and then look north. Jump onto the platform around the edge and then make your way down to the surface. The Nano Suit crate is down there.
Replaces Punk Top on NG+. Head south along the tracks, west to the end of the parking garage, then north onto the platform and down to the surface.
Replaces Punk Style on NG++. Head south along the tracks, west to the end of the parking garage, then north onto the platform and down to the surface.
After clearing all 6 Cocoons, you'll need to follow the objective down a red slide. There will be a Dozer and a Hydra at the end. After they're defeated, climb up the small roof, where the crate is.
Replaces Motivation on NG+. After clearing all 6 Cocoons, follow the objective down the red slide, defeat the Dozer and Hydra, then climb up to the small roof.
Replaces Resonance on NG++. After clearing all 6 Cocoons, follow the objective down the red slide, defeat the Dozer and Hydra, then climb up to the small roof.
Behind the Supply Camp (east side).
Replaces Orca Engineer on NG+. Found behind the Supply Camp on the east side.
Replaces Orca Techie on NG++. Found behind the Supply Camp on the east side.
In the east corner (next to where you need to go) is a laser puzzle room. Approach the box, and then dodge the lasers and make your way to the control panel on the eastern wall.
Replaces Black Rose on NG+. Found in the laser puzzle room in the east corner. Dodge the lasers and reach the control panel on the eastern wall.
Replaces Angelic Rose on NG++. Found in the laser puzzle room in the east corner. Dodge the lasers and reach the control panel on the eastern wall.
After leaving the boss fight arena, this crate is in the next room, straight ahead of you.
Replaces Photogenic on NG+. Found in the crate in the room straight ahead after leaving the boss fight arena.
Reward for defeating all bosses in the Boss Challenge mode on Normal difficulty or higher.
Reward for defeating Raven in the Boss Challenge mode on Hard difficulty .
Reward for defeating Mann in the Boss Challenge mode on Normal difficulty or higher.
Reward for defeating Scarlet in the Boss Challenge mode. Requires the Nikke DLC.
